experiment.benchmark: AMB2018-02: individual laser traces on bare IN625 plates (no powder)

substrate.surface: 320 grit random-orientation polish, Sa 0.44-0.53 um, Sq 0.64-0.73 um
substrate.fixturing: four aluminum pins, minimal-contact fixture to minimize conductive loss
substrate.preheat: not stated in the paper (no preheat mentioned); see deviations.yaml D-V1-11

CBM.thermography: InSb SWIR 1350-1600 nm, 1800 fps, 40 us integration

AMMT.thermography: Si CMOS 850+/-20 nm, 10000 fps, 20 or 100 us integration
AMMT.power_note: AMMT actual powers were 137.9 W (case A) and 179.2 W (cases B,C), not the nominal 150/195 W

measurement_definitions.length: in-situ thermography, front of melt pool to solidification point at 1290 C along track
measurement_definitions.width_depth: ex-situ cross-section microscopy, N=3 sections per track
measurement_definitions.cooling_rate: surface cooling rate at track center from thermal profile, reported for 1290->1190 C and 1290->1000 C bands

reference_values_table4.provenance: NIST measurement -- Lane2020 Table 4 'Compiled summary results' (AM-Bench reference values)
reference_values_table4.unit_note: Table 4 header prints length/width/depth mean and umean columns as (mm); values are unambiguously um (cf. Fig 8 axes in um). Transcribed as um.

cooling_rate_1290_1190_C_per_s.flag: paper says AMMT cooling rates are exemplar only, not recommended as reference (motion blur / calibration range)

per_track_data_table3.provenance: NIST measurement -- Lane2020 Table 3 (per-track); CBM cooling rates also given for 1290->1000 C
per_track_data_table3.note: transcribed only CBM per-track cooling-rate band 1290->1000 C means here; full table in the archived PDF

triangle_anchor.note: Balbaa2022 Fig 8/9/10 'Exp [68]' bars (width 133, depth 91, length 780 um) match CBM case B exactly; therefore Balbaa's single-track validation condition is identified as CBM-B: 195 W, 800 mm/s, bare plate, spot D4sigma 100 um, N2 atmosphere. This resolves deviations D-V1-03 (validation case) and constrains D-V1-02 (spot radius r = 50 um for the code-to-code leg).
